Introduction

The Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, established in the year 2010, is committed to delivering a holistic educational experience that centers on the comprehensive development of its students. Beyond academics, the department emphasizes value-based education, nurturing a sense of social responsibility, integrity, and professionalism among students. A major pillar of this approach is our robust Career Guidance, Training, and Placement Program, designed to empower students for successful career transitions.

Career Guidance Initiatives

To ensure students are aware of various career opportunities and industry trends, the department regularly organizes:

  • Motivational Talks and Expert Lectures: Industry professionals and alumni are invited to share insights, inspire, and guide students on their career paths.
  • Higher Studies Awareness Programs: Sessions on GATE, GRE, and TOEFL are conducted to inform students about higher education options in India and abroad.
  • One-on-One Mentorship: Faculty mentors and placement coordinators provide personalized career guidance based on students' interests and strengths.
  Training Programs The training program is strategically spread across the semesters to gradually build students' skills in alignment with placement expectations:
Year Training Module Details
Second Year Soft Skills Training Communication, teamwork, leadership, and professional etiquette
Aptitude, Verbal & Reasoning (AVR) Training Foundation-level training to enhance problem-solving and logical reasoning skills
Domain-Specific Technical Training ·        Embedded Systems ·        Industrial Automation
Third Year AVR Training Continued aptitude practice with mock tests and performance analytics
Domain-Specific Technical Training ·        Embedded Systems ·        Industrial Automation
Fourth Year Pre-Placement Training Resume building, interview skills, mock interviews, group discussions, and company-specific prep
  Placement Management
  • Faculty Placement Coordinators are assigned to oversee and coordinate all placement-related activities within the department.
  • Student Placement Coordinators assist in managing training schedules, communicating with peers, and ensuring smooth conduct of recruitment drives.
